newsitem.title: INDIA: India zero coupon bonds undersubscribed, says RBI.
newsitem.headline: India zero coupon bonds undersubscribed, says RBI.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said a sale of zero coupon bonds on Monday received applications for 14.93 billion rupees, short of the 20-billion rupee target.
The balance devolved on the RBI and the primary dealers, an RBI statement said. The devolvement on RBI was 4.54 billion and that on primary dealers 527.3 million rupees.
RBI accepted all 45 applications it received.
The zero coupon bonds, 2000 (third series) (second issue) will be eligible for ready forward facility. The bonds will be repayable at par on July 13, 2000.
